query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, s.name as series_name, l.is_active as lesson_is_active, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercise_questions eq join public.exercises e on e.id = eq.exercise_id where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_question_count, coalesce((select bool_and(e.is_active = false and e.is_published = false) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id), false) as exercises_are_drafts, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quiz_questions qq join public.quizzes q on q.id = qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_question_count, coalesce((select bool_and(q.is_active = false and q.is_published = false) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id), false) as quizzes_are_drafts from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id = o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id = o.level_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where l.id in ('e156de9b-da20-448f-976b-9a48c6be17b4','85e5cd41-539e-4ba3-8c8b-392c14a0b026','d3b24f26-e5d7-4cae-9dd5-5c6729ea7da3','1b43a805-c89e-4472-b4c1-45bb7226a822','aec347c0-a680-4ef1-b4f6-67947a1e600c','50398ee8-8130-47eb-ad7c-f2ef9f8ad5d0') and sub.name = 'Mathématiques' and lv.name = 'Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2') order by s.name, lesson_title limit 6;
